newsitem.title: USA: FSA says sees no loss from Olympic.
newsitem.headline: FSA says sees no loss from Olympic.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance, a unit of Financial Security Assurance Holdings Ltd, said Thursday it does not expect to incur any losses from insured auto loan transactions sponsored by Olympic Financial Ltd.
FSA said it currently has a net par exposure of $2.6 billion in securitizations originated by Olympic, which announced Thursday it suffered a net loss of $75 million in the first quarter.
The transactions include 14 insured auto loan securitizations and a warehouse facility backed by prime and non-prime auto loans.

"The transactions are performing very close to our original expectations," Russell Brewer, FSA's managing director and chief underwriter officer, said in a statement. "All FSA-insured transactions are structured to withstand a multiple of expected losses substantially in excess of our base-case estimates."
The statement said all the transactions are cross-collateralized and "structured to build additional reserves in the event of any deteriorations in the portfolio performance."
The transactions have an average life of approximately 1.5 years, according to FSA.
